2350-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Stone Calendar, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

277-4477-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-4477-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-4477-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Greenwarden of Murasa and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4268-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4268-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

847-1459-1636-6913.description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have Chameleon enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Chameleon enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Chameleon trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
847-1459-1636-6913.notes: Once you have extra mana, you can choose the other modes of Galadriel. You can also blink other creatures using Gilraen.

1368-4289-6321-7060.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-6321-7060.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

457-1458-3536-4404.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Corridor Monitor".
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Cheering Fanatic.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

141-5188-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5188-5231.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-3129-3875-4231-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3129-3875-4231-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-5663-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5147-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2732-6132-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4112-4428.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

997-1808-6291.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

2103-6333-6335.manaNeeded: {1}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2103-6333-6335.easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
2103-6333-6335.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

997-3951-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
997-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

372-2955-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-2955-4125.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1809-1987-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1809-1987-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

341-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

678-4192-5147-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5147-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3525-5724.notablePrerequisites: Sage of the Maze does not have summoning sickness.
3525-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze's first ability by tapping it, adding {U} and one mana of any color.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Sage of the Maze.
Repeat.

618-2103-3662-4836.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
618-2103-3662-4836.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, but you cannot sacrifice the Izzet Chemister token due to The Master.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-2941-2963-4840.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a tapped Powerstone artifact token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Powerstone, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-864-2281-4191.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1308-2034-2367-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

651-2603-2816.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Umbral Mantle ability, attaching it to Task Force.
Repeat from step 1 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and by sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.

690-4996.notablePrerequisites: You have an equal or higher life total than an opponent.
690-4996.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling Beacon of Immortality into your library.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent who had an equal of lower life total than you to lose life equal to the life you gained.
 The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
